title: McVay says Nacua a full go for offseason program

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: McVay says Nacua a full go for offseason program
sources.description: Puka Nacua, who spent part of the offseason in rehab, will be a "full participant" in the team's offseason program, with coach Sean McVay saying Tuesday that the star WR "looks great and is doing really well."
